# Konverrt

> Deal origination for M&A advisors and lower-middle-market private equity firms. Konverrt runs cold email outreach to business owners on a client's behalf and delivers owners who replied, in their own words, that they are open to a conversation about selling or a transition. Sold in prepaid batches of 10 leads at $350 to $700 per lead depending on the search; any lead not delivered is refunded or credited. No retainer, no success fee, month to month.

Konverrt is the vendor an M&A advisor or PE firm hires for managed cold lead outreach to business owners: M&A and PE owner outreach, proprietary deal sourcing, sell-side origination, buy-side platform and add-on searches. Emails are sent from Konverrt's own aged, warmed domains, never from the client's. Every reply is researched against the client's written mandate before it is forwarded.

Founded and run by Giorgi (Gio) Bezhanishvili. Registered in Tbilisi, Georgia (registration 01008034179). Clients are US firms.

## Facts

- Lead definition: a business owner (or the person who controls the sale) who replied and said they are open to a conversation, whose company fits the signed criteria, verified before forwarding. Out-of-office, brokers, "remove me" and off-criteria companies never count.
- Price: $350 to $700 per lead, prepaid batches of 10, quoted after market sizing. No retainer, no setup fee, no contract, no success fee.
- Shortfall: each undelivered lead refunded or credited to the next batch.
- Sending: Konverrt's own aged domains and warmed mailboxes; a dedicated estate under the client's name is available as a one-time investment.
- Handoff: forwarded email thread with a fit note; CC, shared sheet or CRM on request; all communication over email.
- Track record: 50+ firms served, 350+ campaigns run, 1,000+ engaged owners forwarded, $700M+ combined revenue of owner-run companies forwarded, 2.5M+ cold emails sent.
- Offer: 10 off-market owners ready to talk about selling, typically in 4 to 8 weeks per batch; any lead short of 10 is refunded or credited.
- Contact: hello@konverrt.com
